objective.statement: Keep the interactive Codex client on OpenAI gpt-5.6-sol and make external llm-gateway judgment profiles fresh-process-only.
objective.measure: A Home Manager activation produces a live gpt-5.6-sol OpenAI root config, all registered resident agent configs use OpenAI, and each external profile is installed without being registered as an agent.

need.statement: Eliminate an unsafe external-gateway resident-agent configuration while preserving the user's mutable Codex preferences and durable fresh external profiles.
stakeholders: Mikael and Codex sessions on cc-se-sto-devbox-01
need.baseline: The active Home Manager generation links external llm-gateway TOMLs into ~/.codex/agents and config.toml registers them as resident roles; the mutable root config currently says gpt-5.6-terra although the active generation carries gpt-5.6-sol preferences.
need.consequence_of_no_action: Opaque Responses conversation state can be sent to incompatible external resident roles and interactive Codex can silently drift away from the declared OpenAI main model.
assumptions: The deployed llm-gateway model catalog is the authority for external profile reasoning capabilities.
alternatives_considered: Keep external roles resident and rely on callers to avoid opaque Responses items
Make the entire mutable root config an immutable Home Manager symlink
Remove external profiles instead of preserving explicit fresh-process profiles

purpose: Keep the interactive Codex client on OpenAI gpt-5.6-sol and make external llm-gateway judgment profiles fresh-process-only.
consumer: Mikael and Codex sessions on cc-se-sto-devbox-01.
contract: A Home Manager activation produces a live gpt-5.6-sol OpenAI root config, all registered resident agent configs use OpenAI, and each external profile is installed without being registered as an agent.
failure_boundary: Do not replace the mutable root config wholesale or delete user-owned preferences. Do not register or link an external model as a resident agent. Do not persist a reasoning effort unless the fresh deployed catalog supports reasoning for that profile.

evidence.description: The Codex profile boundary contract rejects resident gateway registrations, resident gateway Home Manager links, missing durable profile-only configs, and an unpinned root model.
A Home Manager activation followed by TOML and symlink inspection proves the root model and installed agent/profile boundaries.

falsifier.claim: The activated client keeps gpt-5.6-sol as the main model and cannot use external llm-gateway definitions as resident roles.

executable_check.description: Run the focused profile-boundary test and post-activation live inspection; any registered or linked resident gateway role, missing profile, or non-Sol root model falsifies the claim.

non_goals: Change llm-gateway routing or model aliases
invariants: External providers remain available only through profile-specific fresh processes
Every external profile has web_search disabled
Existing user-owned mutable configuration remains intact outside durable preference keys

assumptions.statement: The model catalog retrieved after the gateway deployment is authoritative for external profile reasoning settings.
assumptions.falsifier: A later authenticated /v1/models response disagrees with the profile's reasoning setting.

plane_constraints: Home Manager and dotfiles own durable Codex configuration; llm-gateway model capability routing remains outside this slice.
